clues.text: King Omri bought this hill from Shemer for two talents of silver and built a city on it.
Before His ascension, Jesus told the apostles they would be His witnesses in Jerusalem, all Judea, and here.
Elisha led a blinded Aramean army into this city, then prayed for their eyes to be opened.
Naaman's young Israelite servant girl said a prophet in this city could cure her master's leprosy.
The king of Assyria besieged this city for three years, captured it, and exiled the Israelites.
On His way from Judea to Galilee, Jesus had to pass through here and stopped at Jacob's well.
Philip preached Christ in a city here, where Simon the sorcerer had long amazed the people.
